messages.content: 十二月洛杉磯的平均溫度是多少？

function.name: calculate_bmi

height.description: The height of the person in meters. This is a float type value.

message.content:
在洛杉磯，12 月份的氣候相對溫和。根據歷史氣象數據：

| 日期 | 平均最高溫（°C） | 平均最低溫（°C） | 平均溫度（°C） |
|------|------------------|------------------|----------------|
| 12 月 | 約 21°C (70°F)   | 約 11°C (52°F)   | 約 16°C (61°F) |

換句話說，12 月份洛杉磯的平均日間溫度大約是 16°C（61°F）。如果你計畫旅行或外出，建議攜帶輕薄外套或長袖衣物，以應對早晚較涼的天氣。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "十二月洛杉磯的平均溫度是多少？" which translates to "What is the average temperature in Los Angeles in December?" They want an answer about average temperature. We can provide approximate data. According to climate data, average high ~21°C (70°F), average low ~11°C (52°F). So average maybe around 16°C (61°F). Provide explanation. No tool needed.
